The season ran from 24 September 2022 until 21 May 2023.[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/ango2023.html Angola 2022/23], RSSSF.com[https://www.jornaldeangola.ao/ao/noticias/girabola-2022-2023-arranca-no-proximo-dia-27-de-agosto/ Girabola 2022-2023 arranca no próximo dia 27 de Agosto], JornaldeAngola.ao[https://www.angop.ao/noticias/desporto/girabola-inicia-hoje-com-luanda-subaternizada-em-numero-de-equipas/ Girabola arranca com Luanda superada em equipas], Angop.ao The league comprised 16 teams, the bottom three of which were relegated to the 2023–24 [[Angolan Provincial Football Stage|Provincial stages]].
